title: Notes confirmation feature
description: Add a local notes form with responsive layout and save confirmation.
assumptions: Ephemeral in-page state only; no backend writes.

environment.setup: Project runner: ensure an owned loopback environment for this claimed candidate using the common review profile; report exact session and origin.
environment.cleanup: Project runner: release only exact owner/session and preserve code; reconcile interrupted setup before continuation.
environment.browser_adapter: Project Playwright browser adapter for sealed scenarios

actions: Use keyboard and submit isolated test form
expectations: Observe empty/loading/error/success states and labelled keyboard flow

checks.description: Check index.html contains the declared notes form; python3 -B -c "from pathlib import Path; assert 'addEventListener' in Path('index.html').read_text()"

security.description: Inspect index.html notes form for unsafe script execution, outbound effects or exposed secrets; only ephemeral in-page state is authorized.

review.description: Inspect scoped notes confirmation: hide empty state, show Saved: <trimmed note>, clear input and restore focus; preserve existing error/loading behavior, responsive design and form IDs.
